feed.connectedHelp: Search the native apps together, with editing-focused category searches and videos you can watch and save here.
feed.connectedSetup: Open the Discover helper in Chrome and choose Connect Discover, then return here.
feed.connectedLibraryHelp: This is a limited collection of previously found references. Its counts do not represent everything on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.
feed.connectedOrderHelp: The apps’ search results, mixed across platforms. Videos stay visible while details are checked; appearing here does not establish that an edit is trending.
feed.connectedCached: Your last search, saved on this device:
feed.connectedLoading: Gathering videos from the native apps…
feed.connectedError: The connection stopped. Check the helper and try again; completed results remain here.
feed.connectedPlatformAttention: open to sign in or continue
feed.connectedPlatformNoResults: no videos for this exact search — open search
feed.connectedNoPopular: No received videos meet all recent-popularity checks yet. Native search order still shows the full result set.
feed.connectedNoResults: No videos received yet. Search all three apps, or open a platform above if it needs attention.
feed.connectedScrollMore: Keep scrolling through available videos. If source tabs are needed, open them with the button below.
feed.connectedPopularLoaded: Showing {shown} popular matches from {loaded} loaded videos.
feed.connectedWindow: Showing the latest loaded results; earlier results were unloaded to keep browsing responsive. Saved videos are kept.
feed.nativeFormatHelp: Choose up to 6 videos and an editing format to review them against. These are unverified leads. Adding them runs no source checks or AI.
feed.nativeFormatImported: {n} selected links are in this format’s review queue. No source or AI check has run.
feed.nativeImportHelp: Choose the videos and their category. Discover will check available source details after you add them. They may appear in Explore while editing relevance and popularity are unverified. This does not save favourites or change your preferences.
feed.nativeImported: {n} selected links are in this category. Source checks and feed requirements determine which videos appear here.
feed.nativeInvalid: This import link is invalid. Return to the search page and select the videos again.
feed.title: {genre} edits
feed.forYouHelp: Editing references from categories you’ve explored. Your saved ideas and feedback help shape this selection.
feed.chooseCategoryHelp: Open a category to find more references. This feed uses posts already found, without running another search.
feed.inspirationHelp: Editing references chosen for technique and relevance. Preview them to judge the edit.
feed.popularHelp: Recent examples with substantial engagement checked on the source. Popularity alone does not prove a trend or a great edit.
feed.popularPolicy: Posted within 30 days; counts checked within 3 days. Instagram uses likes when available, TikTok and YouTube use views. The minimum selected count is 1,000 likes or 25,000 views on Instagram / TikTok, and 250 likes or 10,000 views on YouTube. These are selection rules, not a score for editing quality.
feed.learningHelp: Tutorials and breakdowns that describe teaching the technique. Useful lessons do not need lots of likes.
feed.exploreHelp: Wider matches, including smaller creators and posts with limited evidence. These are leads to explore.
feed.empty: No edits meet this feed’s requirements yet.
feed.emptyPopular: No recent examples have enough checked engagement for this feed yet.
feed.emptyLearning: No clear lessons found yet. Tutorial announcements and requests do not count as lessons.
feed.shortage: A small selection is all we can support so far. We won’t fill it with unrelated videos.
feed.checkRemainingHelp: Checks a small batch of existing Instagram and TikTok links in this category. Uses no search or AI credits.
feed.searchCost: Up to {n} platform lookups; credit costs vary.
feed.findMoreHelp: Search for another small batch. Changing modes or feedback does not run a search.
feed.noMore: No more searches are available for this feed right now.
feed.localOnly: Saved on this device. This does not change your Instagram or TikTok feed.
feed.moreSaved: You’ll see more similar techniques here.
feed.creatorHidden: This creator is hidden from your feed.
feed.sourceRead: Post details checked. The footage has not been reviewed.
feed.indexed: Suggested by search text. It may not describe the video accurately.
feed.noEvidence: Limited details available. Preview it before using it as a reference.
feed.personal: Your saved references or feedback influenced this recommendation.
feed.searchPartial: {platform}: only part of the search completed ({n} posts returned).
feed.searchAuth: The search provider refused the key.
feed.searchUpstream: The search service did not respond.
feed.searchFiltered: These totals are before feed filters.
feed.refillHelp: Search all dates for useful examples and lessons. Reuses a saved search when available; otherwise starts a new lookup.
feed.refillCost: Up to {web} web lookups + {youtube} YouTube searches; credit costs vary.
feed.quotaHelp: The last live search reached this source’s allowance. Choose another available platform; saved searches may still work below.
feed.referenceHelp: Bring a post you found in your own feed. This saves a personal reference without a paid search; public post details may be checked.
feed.referenceUrl: Instagram, TikTok or YouTube post link
feed.referenceKeep: Keep in my inspiration — my personal selection, not verified trend evidence.
feed.referenceInvalid: Paste a full Instagram reel, TikTok video or YouTube video link.
feed.referenceNoteFull: Your existing saved note has no room for this addition. Open Saved to edit it first.
feed.personalUnverified: Chosen by you. The video’s content and popularity are unverified.
feed.tiktokAccessHelp: Check the stored advertiser connection, then make at most one TikTok hashtag access request for this category (US, 7 days). This check adds no videos and uses no web search or AI.
feed.tiktokAccessConfig: Configure Scout in Settings before checking access.
feed.tiktokAccessStored: Advertiser connection stored. This alone does not confirm Discovery permission.
feed.tiktokAccessAbsent: No usable advertiser connection is stored. Your normal TikTok login is separate.
feed.tiktokAccessNoAdvertiser: A connection is stored, but no advertiser account is available for this check.
feed.tiktokAccessAccepted: TikTok accepted this hashtag request and returned {n} hashtags. Video access and editing relevance are still untested.
feed.tiktokFindSeen: You already have the posts returned by this chart. Try the other region or check again when the chart changes. Your existing feed is kept.
feed.tiktokFindHelp: Look for posts using this category’s popular TikTok hashtags ({region}, past 7 days). Each click checks a small batch you don’t already have. Uses no web-search credits or AI. Posts still need source and editing checks.
feed.tiktokFindNoTags: This region’s current chart has no matching category tags. Try the other region. Your existing feed is kept.
feed.tiktokFindResult: Retrieved {n} TikTok posts for checking. Only posts that pass the feed’s checks appear as inspiration; this is not a count of new or verified trending edits.
feed.tiktokFindEmpty: TikTok returned no usable posts for this category. Your existing feed is kept.
feed.tiktokAccessEmpty: TikTok accepted this hashtag request but returned no hashtags. This does not mean the category has no useful edits.
feed.tiktokAccessAuth: TikTok did not accept the stored authorization. Discovery access is unconfirmed.
feed.tiktokAccessPermission: TikTok denied this Discovery request. The stored connection does not grant this access.
feed.tiktokAccessQuota: TikTok limited this request. Access remains unconfirmed; no retry was made.
feed.tiktokAccessWorkerAuth: Scout did not accept its configured access token. TikTok permission was not checked.
feed.tiktokAccessUpgrade: This Scout version does not provide the access-check endpoint. TikTok permission was not checked.
feed.tiktokAccessNetwork: The access check could not connect. No permission conclusion is available.
feed.tiktokAccessTimeout: The access check timed out. No automatic retry was made.
feed.tiktokAccessCancelled: Check cancelled. A request already sent may still finish.
feed.tiktokAccessMalformed: The response was not a valid access-check result. Access remains unconfirmed.
feed.tiktokAccessUpstream: The access check failed. This does not confirm a permission denial or an empty category.
feed.tiktokAccessChecked: Checked {date} · US · 7 days · hashtag access only
feed.deepSearchHint: Source tabs open only when you press a button. Scrolling reveals saved videos or continues a live background search. Showing source tabs may load more results.
feed.deepSkipped: Deep search needs Discover in front to load more — showing normal results.
feed.soundsHonest: Counted from Instagram, TikTok and YouTube videos Discover has read — trending and emerging use the last 14 days, “seen in edits” the last 30 — not an official chart.
feed.soundsEmpty: This fills up as Discover reads videos: open a category or search a style, and sounds used by several creators show up here.
feed.soundsRefreshDone: Done: {count} sounds read from the posts found.
feed.soundsRefreshError: Couldn't refresh: make sure the Chrome helper is connected and no other search is running, then try again.
